scenicChapters.title: Santa María del Agua de Landa → San Francisco del Valle de Tilaco
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 18 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

sections.advice: S.K.Grieg's Estate «Sans Ennui» → Park «The Menagerie» is 56 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Park «The Menagerie» → Koltushskoe Highway is 62 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Koltushskoe Highway → back through Park «The Menagerie» is 62 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
back through Park «The Menagerie» → S.K.Grieg's Estate «Sans Ennui» is 56 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 61 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-s-k-grieg-s-estate-sans-ennui-kol.story: From Lomonosov it runs 256 km to Lomonosov; allow about 4 h 25 of riding. On the way it passes Park «The Menagerie», Koltushskoe Highway and back through Park «The Menagerie». It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
